title: kbfacts.terms reads any hyphenated single-digit pair as a dotted version, so a SID such as S-1-5-18 packs as 1.5
goal: terms() maps a hyphenated version to a dotted one only inside a model id (claude-opus-5-5 to 5.5), never inside a SID or another hyphenated token: terms('S-1-5-18') holds no '1.5', and pack 'default value 1.5' no longer leads with a settings-crosswalk.csv SID row. Introduced by ST-z5uh6oj7's VERSION_ID; found by the SP-5i4itd2d review.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import kbfacts; t=kbfacts.terms('S-1-5-18'); print(t); sys.exit(1 if '1.5' in t else 0)
